about_the_game:
The mind may be split in two, but the goal remains one: Unity.

Mind Split is a top-down puzzle game that challenges you to control two characters moving in opposite directions at the same time.

CREATE YOUR OWN PATH: PLAN, PLACE, EXECUTE…

With the editor mode, you can place the abilities you need in designated areas before the level begins.
Careful planning is essential: Which ability will help which character? Think ahead, position wisely, and test your strategy.
But beware—there's no going back once you've made your move.

BRING LIGHT AND SHADOW TOGETHER: TWO DIRECTIONS, ONE PURPOSE!

In this unique puzzle experience, you control two characters simultaneously—one can only move in the dark, while the other can only walk in the light.
You’ll need to balance both sides, master the rules of their worlds, and switch between light and shadow with precision.
Timing, strategy, and insight will be your greatest allies on this journey.

Plan. Execute. Find the balance.
Can Light and Shadow be united once again?

Trailer Music: Dj Quads – It Just Makes Me Happy

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: A top-down puzzle game where you discover the harmony of opposites. Control Light and Shadow with a single mind as they move in opposite directions—use strategic moves to bring them together. Balance each step, challenge your mind in every level!
